classification.difficultyReason: Following the completed example, convert bearings into directional sketches and complete right triangles with correctly placed horizontal and vertical components.

content.prompt:
Sketch the bearing, label the distance, show the angle made with North or South.
Then label the vertical ($y$) and horizontal ($x$) distance travelled.
The first question has been done for you.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Ike walked 11 km at a bearing of $125^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$.

answer.short: $\mathrm{S}55^{\circ}\mathrm{E}$; label the travel leg $11\,\mathrm{km}$, the horizontal component $x$ and the vertical component $y$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Angle from South} &= 180^{\circ}-125^{\circ}\\&=55^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$
Draw the travel leg southeast and label it $11\,\mathrm{km}$. Mark $55^{\circ}$ between South and the leg. Complete the right triangle with a southward vertical side labelled $y$ and an eastward horizontal side labelled $x$.

spec.description: Completed southeast bearing sketch with perpendicular component triangle.
spec.mathematics: 125°T is S55°E. The travel leg is 11 km; x is horizontal and y is vertical. The right angle is at the lower left.
spec.answerVisibility: Hidden teaching-answer evidence; shown only in answers.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Nidal swam for 2.6 km at a bearing of $250^{\circ}\mathrm{T}$.

answer.short: $\mathrm{S}70^{\circ}\mathrm{W}$; label the travel leg $2.6\,\mathrm{km}$, the horizontal component $x$ and the vertical component $y$.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}\text{Angle from South} &=250^{\circ}-180^{\circ}\\&=70^{\circ}\end{aligned}$$
Draw the travel leg southwest and label it $2.6\,\mathrm{km}$. Mark $70^{\circ}$ between South and the leg. Complete the right triangle with a southward vertical side labelled $y$ and a horizontal side labelled $x$.

spec.description: Completed southwest bearing sketch with horizontal dashed component.
spec.mathematics: 250°T is S70°W. The travel leg is 2.6 km; x is horizontal and y is vertical. The right angle is at the lower right.

children.label: d

answer.worked: Draw the travel leg $25^{\circ}$ west of North and label it $8\,\mathrm{km}$. Complete the right triangle with a northward vertical side labelled $y$ and an upper horizontal side labelled $x$. Mark the right angle where the components meet.

spec.description: Completed northwest bearing sketch with upper horizontal dashed component.
spec.mathematics: The leg is 25° west of North and represents 8 km. The right angle is at the upper right; x is horizontal and y is vertical.
